description: This source file implements a file-based timer system for distributed workers, including classes for timer requests, client, and server, with mechanisms for reattempting connections, managing timers, and reaping worker processes based on expiration signals.

classes.name: FileTimerRequest
classes.description: Represents a timer request with expiration and signal info, used between client and server.

classes.name: FileTimerClient
classes.description: Client class for sending timer requests via a FIFO pipe to the server, used on the same host.

classes.name: FileTimerServer
classes.description: Server class that manages timers, handles requests, and reaps worker processes based on timer expiration signals.

methods.name: _retry
methods.description: Decorator for retrying a function call with specified max retries and sleep interval.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes a FileTimerRequest to JSON string.

methods.name: acquire
methods.description: Sends a request to acquire a timer with a specific expiration time.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Sends a request to release a timer for a scope.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the watchdog thread for the server.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the server and its watchdog thread, removing the FIFO pipe.

methods.name: run_once
methods.description: Runs the server loop once, then stops.

methods.name: is_process_running
methods.description: Checks if a process with a given PID is running.

methods.name: _watchdog_loop
methods.description: Main loop for the server to monitor and process timer requests.

methods.name: _run_watchdog
methods.description: Processes expired timers, reaps workers, and manages timers.

methods.name: _get_requests
methods.description: Reads timer requests from the FIFO pipe within a max interval.

methods.name: register_timers
methods.description: Registers incoming timer requests, adding or removing timers.

methods.name: clear_timers
methods.description: Removes timers associated with completed or dead worker processes.

methods.name: get_expired_timers
methods.description: Returns timers that have expired by a given deadline.

methods.name: _reap_worker
methods.description: Sends a signal to terminate a worker process.

methods.name: get_last_progress_time
methods.description: Returns the last time the server made progress or checked in.
